description: This file defines the main layout and application structure for a React-based frontend of a college bus tracking system, utilizing Remix framework features such as routing, meta, links, and context providers.

methods.name: links
methods.description: Function providing link tags for preconnecting to fonts and including Google Fonts stylesheet.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: React component that provides the overall HTML structure, including head metadata and body wrapper for child components.

methods.name: Shell
methods.description: React component that structures the main application layout with header, sidebar, main content outlet, and footer. Manages sidebar open state and route change side effects.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Root React component that wraps the application with an authentication context and includes the layout shell.
